TABLE.NAME: gmk_contract
TABLE.COMMENT: This table contains the list of contracts.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the user related to the contract.

FIELD.NAME: lpid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the learning plan.

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: The type of the contract: individual = "Contrato individual"; institutional = "Contrato institucional"

FIELD.NAME: code
FIELD.COMMENT: This internal code is automatically generated when the contract is fully approved.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: This field indicates what is the status of the contract; let's use a small number to manage this concept of status.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_tuition
TABLE.COMMENT: Table to manage the tuitions of the students

FIELD.NAME: amount
FIELD.COMMENT: The amount payed by the user.

FIELD.NAME: paymentmethod
FIELD.COMMENT: The payment method used by the user.

FIELD.NAME: paymentdate
FIELD.COMMENT: The date of the payment.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_orders
TABLE.COMMENT: This table stores all orders related to the different products or payable items in the platform.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: THe ID of the order is related with.

FIELD.NAME: oid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the order that will be sent to the payment method, and then validated when the callback is called.

FIELD.NAME: itemtype
FIELD.COMMENT: The type of payable item. Ex: tuition, credit, contract_fee....

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: The status of the order: Ex - PENDING, APPROVED, SUCCESS....

FIELD.NAME: amount
FIELD.COMMENT: Amount to pay, or payed.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_class
TABLE.COMMENT: This table contains the classes used by the learning plans

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: name of the class

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: type of the class, either inplace(0) or virtual(1)

FIELD.NAME: learningplanid
FIELD.COMMENT: Id of the learning plan

FIELD.NAME: periodid
FIELD.COMMENT: Id of the period

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Id of the course

FIELD.NAME: instructorid
FIELD.COMMENT: Id of the instructor

FIELD.NAME: inittime
FIELD.COMMENT: Init time of the class

FIELD.NAME: endtime
FIELD.COMMENT: End time of the class

FIELD.NAME: initdate
FIELD.COMMENT: Start date of the class period

FIELD.NAME: enddate
FIELD.COMMENT: End date of the class period

FIELD.NAME: classdays
FIELD.COMMENT: Days when the class is dictated, the format is L/M/M/J/V/S/D, and the values that take each day is between 0 and 1, 0 for no dictated, 1 for dictated

FIELD.NAME: groupid
FIELD.COMMENT: The id of the group created for the class

FIELD.NAME: coursesectionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The section id of the course created for the class

FIELD.NAME: supportinstructorid
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional support teacher with the same Moodle-level capabilities as instructorid for this class only. Admin/director managed.

FIELD.NAME: is_module
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = independent study module, 0 = regular class

FIELD.NAME: module_deadline_days
FIELD.COMMENT: Days from enrollment before student deadline expires

TABLE.NAME: gmk_academic_deferrals
TABLE.COMMENT: Student group movements (deferrals)

TABLE.NAME: gmk_student_deferrals
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-student subject projection movements

TABLE.NAME: gmk_grace_period
TABLE.COMMENT: Periodos de gracia por primer login de estudiante

TABLE.COMMENT: Per-student independent module enrollment with individual deadline

FIELD.NAME: classid
FIELD.COMMENT: gmk_class.id where is_module=1

FIELD.NAME: enrolldate
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of enrollment

FIELD.NAME: duedate
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of deadline

TABLE.NAME: gmk_module_invoice_requests
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-student module enrollment requests with Odoo invoice + payment state

FIELD.NAME: invoice_extref
FIELD.COMMENT: External request ref sent to Odoo (MODULE_REQ:<id>)

FIELD.NAME: invoice_id
FIELD.COMMENT: Odoo account.move id

FIELD.NAME: invoice_number
FIELD.COMMENT: Odoo invoice consecutive (name)

FIELD.NAME: enrolled_classid
FIELD.COMMENT: gmk_class.id assigned after enrollment

FIELD.NAME: expires_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp after which the request auto-expires

TABLE.NAME: gmk_student_observations
TABLE.COMMENT: Observaciones de seguimiento por estudiante y clase

TABLE.NAME: gmk_class_closure_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Audit log for class closures — records who closed, when, and the grade summary at closure time

FIELD.NAME: closedby
FIELD.COMMENT: userid of the admin who triggered the close

FIELD.NAME: notes
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional notes or error context

TABLE.NAME: gmk_revalidations
TABLE.COMMENT: Teacher-driven revalidations: scheduled BBB session, Odoo invoice and resolved grade per student/class

FIELD.NAME: originalgrade
FIELD.COMMENT: Final course grade before revalidation

FIELD.NAME: revalidgrade
FIELD.COMMENT: Grade the teacher enters for the revalidation exam

FIELD.NAME: bbbcmid
FIELD.COMMENT: course_module id of the revalidation BBB session

FIELD.NAME: invoice_extref
FIELD.COMMENT: External request ref sent to Odoo (REVALID_REQ:<id>)

FIELD.NAME: invoice_id
FIELD.COMMENT: Odoo account.move id

FIELD.NAME: invoice_number
FIELD.COMMENT: Odoo invoice consecutive (name)

FIELD.NAME: alert_sent_at
FIELD.COMMENT: When the scheduled-revalidation notice was sent to the student

FIELD.NAME: alert_dismissed_at
FIELD.COMMENT: When the student dismissed the LXP popup (0 = still showing)

TABLE.NAME: gmk_academic_alerts
TABLE.COMMENT: Persistent academic alerts for students in critical states (e.g. finished cycle with pending courses)

FIELD.NAME: detail_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON payload describing the alert context (pending courses, etc.)

FIELD.NAME: messagetext
FIELD.COMMENT: Human readable message describing the alert

TABLE.NAME: gmk_bbb_presence
TABLE.COMMENT: Accumulated per-student presence time in BBB virtual sessions (for 70% auto-attendance).

TABLE.NAME: gmk_diploma_template
TABLE.COMMENT: Diploma templates: visual layout for graduation certificates.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_diploma_tpl_field
TABLE.COMMENT: Layout fields/variables positioned inside a diploma template.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_diploma_generation
TABLE.COMMENT: Generated diploma records (one per student per template issuance).

TABLE.NAME: gmk_diploma_document
TABLE.COMMENT: File storage metadata for generated diploma PDFs.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_admin_message
TABLE.COMMENT: Broadcast announcements published by admins to be shown in the student LXP. Carries priority so it can take precedence over other notifications (e.g. absence alerts).

FIELD.NAME: authorid
FIELD.COMMENT: User id of the Moodle account that created the broadcast.

FIELD.NAME: messagetext
FIELD.COMMENT: HTML/plain body of the announcement shown to students.

FIELD.NAME: messagetype
FIELD.COMMENT: Severity/styling: info (green) | warning (orange)

FIELD.NAME: audience_scope
FIELD.COMMENT: all | career | group

FIELD.NAME: audience_careerid
FIELD.COMMENT: learning_plan.id when scope=career

FIELD.NAME: audience_groupid
FIELD.COMMENT: group.id when scope=group

FIELD.NAME: require_ack
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = the student must acknowledge; 0 = informational only

FIELD.NAME: ack_label
FIELD.DEFAULT: He leído y estoy de acuerdo

FIELD.NAME: priority
FIELD.COMMENT: Higher value = higher precedence. Default 50 beats absence alerts (default 10).

FIELD.NAME: starts_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional unix timestamp before which the broadcast is hidden.

FIELD.NAME: ends_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional unix timestamp after which the broadcast stops surfacing.

FIELD.NAME: active
FIELD.COMMENT: Soft-delete / disable flag; 1 = active, 0 = disabled.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_admin_message_ack
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-user acknowledgements of an admin message. One row per (message, user); presence means the student accepted it.

FIELD.NAME: acknowledged
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if the user clicked accept, 0 if dismissed without ack (only meaningful when require_ack=0).

TABLE.NAME: gmk_admin_message_user
TABLE.COMMENT: Materialised audience: one row per (message, recipient). Lets us resolve counting by career without re-querying every UI load.

FIELD.NAME: careerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of the user's career at the moment the broadcast was published.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_homologation_audit
TABLE.COMMENT: Audit log of homologate / revert actions for the academic panel grades modal.

FIELD.NAME: gcp_id
FIELD.COMMENT: gmk_course_progre.id at the time of the action

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: Homologation type at the time of the action (suficiencia|migracion|homologacion|practica|empty)

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Grade at the time of the action

FIELD.NAME: course_status
FIELD.COMMENT: gmk_course_progre.status after the action

FIELD.NAME: observation
FIELD.COMMENT: Observation captured at the time of the action

FIELD.NAME: previous_observation
FIELD.COMMENT: For revert only: the observation that was cleared

FIELD.NAME: previous_grade
FIELD.COMMENT: For revert only: the grade that was cleared

FIELD.NAME: previous_status
FIELD.COMMENT: For revert only: the status that was cleared

FIELD.NAME: previous_type
FIELD.COMMENT: For revert only: the type that was cleared

TABLE.NAME: gmk_homologation_rules
TABLE.COMMENT: Reusable homologation rules: maps an origin course (in an origin learning plan) to a destination course (in a destination plan). Consumed by the Homologation Manager to preview and bulk-apply homologations across students enrolled in both plans.

FIELD.NAME: origin_planid
FIELD.COMMENT: local_learning_plans.id of the origin plan

FIELD.NAME: origin_courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: course.id of the origin subject

FIELD.NAME: dest_planid
FIELD.COMMENT: local_learning_plans.id of the destination plan (may equal origin_planid for intra-plan homologations)

FIELD.NAME: dest_courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: course.id of the destination subject

TABLE.NAME: gmk_financial_webhook_dlq
TABLE.COMMENT: Dead-letter queue for failed Moodle financial webhook events pushed from Express /api/odoo/cache/invalidate. Lets admins inspect, retry or resolve deliveries that did not make it through after 3 attempts.

FIELD.NAME: partner_vat
FIELD.COMMENT: res.partner.vat from Odoo (== user_info_data.documentnumber in Moodle)

FIELD.NAME: invoice_id
FIELD.COMMENT: account.move.id from Odoo (empty for contract_type_changed)

FIELD.NAME: payload
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw JSON body of the original webhook for forensics

TABLE.NAME: gmk_wellness_partner_category
TABLE.COMMENT: Categories for student-benefit partners (Salud, Retail, Tecnologia, Educacion, etc). Seeded by admin and shown in the catalog filter dropdown.

FIELD.NAME: slug
FIELD.COMMENT: URL-safe version of the name (auto-derived if empty).

TABLE.NAME: gmk_wellness_partner
TABLE.COMMENT: Corporate or institutional partners offering student benefits (RF-01). Visibility in the LXP is gated by active=1 and the validity window.

FIELD.NAME: categoryid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to gmk_wellness_partner_category.id

FIELD.NAME: benefit_description
FIELD.COMMENT: Short description of the benefit (one or two lines).

FIELD.NAME: startdate
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts when the benefit becomes valid. 0 = always.

FIELD.NAME: enddate
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts when the benefit expires. 0 = never.

FIELD.NAME: contact_label
FIELD.COMMENT: e.g. Telefono, WhatsApp, Sitio web, Correo.

FIELD.NAME: logo_path
FIELD.COMMENT: Pluginfile path within the wellness_partner filearea.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_wellness_event
TABLE.COMMENT: Wellness events: sports tournaments, fairs, talks and workshops (RF-02, RF-04, RF-05). Drives the wellness calendar and the LXP catalog.

FIELD.NAME: summary
FIELD.COMMENT: One-line teaser shown on cards.

FIELD.NAME: capacity
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = unlimited.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_wellness_event_attachment
TABLE.COMMENT: Downloadable material attached to a wellness event: handout, recording, link to virtual room.

FIELD.NAME: url
FIELD.COMMENT: External URL (when kind=link) or pluginfile URL.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_wellness_registration
TABLE.COMMENT: Student registration to a wellness event. UNIQUE (eventid, userid) so a single student cannot double-book; the source field distinguishes back-office entries from self-registration.

FIELD.NAME: modality
FIELD.COMMENT: presencial|virtual — the modality the student picked if the event is mixto.

FIELD.NAME: registered_by
FIELD.COMMENT: userid of the staff that performed the registration, if source=backoffice.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_wellness_dynamic_form
TABLE.COMMENT: Dynamic registration form attached to an event (RF-06). The schema_json describes the fields the student must fill; the LXP renders a schema-driven form.

FIELD.NAME: eventid
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional FK to gmk_wellness_event.id. NULL means the form is reusable across events.

FIELD.NAME: schema_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON Schema (https://json-schema.org) describing the form fields. Required keys: fields[]; each field has {name,label,type,required,options?}.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_wellness_dynamic_form_response
TABLE.COMMENT: Materialised student answers to a dynamic form. UNIQUE (formid, userid) so re-submission updates rather than duplicates.

FIELD.NAME: eventid
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of the form's eventid at submission time.

FIELD.NAME: answers_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON object {field_name: value}.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_wellness_psychology_schedule_slot
TABLE.COMMENT: Recurring availability slots published by the psychology specialist. A slot defines a weekday + time range during which students can request appointments.

FIELD.NAME: psychologist_userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id (must hold manage_psychology_appointments or be in the gmk_wellness_staff_role table with rolekey=psicologo_*).

FIELD.NAME: weekday
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=Sunday … 6=Saturday.

FIELD.NAME: starttime
FIELD.COMMENT: HH:MM (24h).

FIELD.NAME: endtime
FIELD.COMMENT: HH:MM (24h).

FIELD.NAME: duration_minutes
FIELD.COMMENT: Default duration per appointment created from this slot.

FIELD.NAME: location
FIELD.COMMENT: Office / virtual room URL.

FIELD.NAME: valid_from
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts; 0 = always.

FIELD.NAME: valid_until
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts; 0 = never.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_wellness_psychology_appointment
TABLE.COMMENT: Psychology appointments requested by students. status transitions: pendiente → confirmada | modificada | cancelada → atendida | no_asistio.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Student who requested the appointment.

FIELD.NAME: slotid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to gmk_wellness_psychology_schedule_slot.id. NULL when booked ad-hoc.

FIELD.NAME: psychologist_userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of the assigned specialist at booking time.

FIELD.NAME: appointment_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts of the appointment (already adjusted to the chosen slot's weekday).

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Reason for the appointment (free text).

FIELD.NAME: status_changed_by
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle userid that performed the last status change (staff or system).

FIELD.NAME: attendees_notes
FIELD.COMMENT: Internal notes added by the specialist after the appointment.

FIELD.NAME: student_notified_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts; updated whenever a notification is sent to the student.

FIELD.NAME: staff_notified_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts; updated whenever a notification is sent to the staff.

FIELD.NAME: cancelled_by
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = system; otherwise Moodle userid (student or staff).

TABLE.NAME: gmk_wellness_staff_role
TABLE.COMMENT: Editable mapping of wellness operational rolekeys to Moodle users + explicit institutional email. Replaces the legacy wellness_psychology_email_dulce / _jorge settings. UNIQUE (rolekey, active) ensures at most one active row per rolekey.

FIELD.NAME: rolekey
FIELD.COMMENT: psicologo_titular|psicologo_suplente|talento_humano|bienestar_jefe|bienestar_asistente. UNIQUE — historical changes are kept in gmk_wellness_staff_audit, not here.

FIELD.NAME: role_label
FIELD.COMMENT: Display label e.g. Dulce Jurado — Talento Humano.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id. 0 means the role is unassigned (no email will be sent).

FIELD.NAME: email_override
FIELD.COMMENT: Explicit institutional email. When empty, user.email is used. Use this when notifications should go to a shared mailbox instead of the personal account.

FIELD.NAME: notify_on_request
FIELD.COMMENT: Send notifications on new appointments.

FIELD.NAME: notify_on_change
FIELD.COMMENT: Send notifications on status changes.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_wellness_staff_audit
TABLE.COMMENT: Audit trail of changes to gmk_wellness_staff_role: who swapped Dulce for someone else, when, and from which email.

FIELD.NAME: changed_by
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle userid of the admin who made the change.

FIELD.NAME: note
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional reason / handoff note from the admin.

TABLE.NAME: gmk_wellness_carnet
TABLE.COMMENT: Student digital ID card (RF-07). One row per userid; qr_token is a random 40-char secret used by the public verifier; valid_until drives both front-end display and back-end rejection of expired cards.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id. UNIQUE.

FIELD.NAME: fullname
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of fullname at issue time.

FIELD.NAME: documentnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Student id / cedula.

FIELD.NAME: learning_plan_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Career / programme name snapshot.

FIELD.NAME: admission_date
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts; 0 = unknown.

FIELD.NAME: valid_from
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts.

FIELD.NAME: valid_until
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts; default = issued_at + wellness_carnet_validity_months (12 by default).

FIELD.NAME: qr_token
FIELD.COMMENT: Random secret used in the QR URL. UNIQUE — regenerate to invalidate an old card.

FIELD.NAME: photo_path
FIELD.COMMENT: Pluginfile path within the wellness_carnet_photo filearea. Empty = falls back to user.picture profile photo.

FIELD.NAME: revoked_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts; non-zero when the carnet was suspended/revoked.
